prompt.default: one full-body subject in a polished three-quarter architectural lean, one shoulder blade or upper hip making clear physically plausible contact with a single support surface, supporting leg stable while the other ankle crosses lightly in front with a relaxed knee, torso elongated rather than collapsed, shoulders relaxed, complete head-to-feet figure visible, contact does not deform or conceal the principal garment

label.th: ลุคบุ๊กเงาหน้าต่าง

description.en: An editorial contrapposto designed for graphic light and a strong fashion silhouette.
description.th: ท่าคอนทราโพสโตแบบเอดิทอเรียลสำหรับแสงกราฟิกและซิลูเอตแฟชั่นที่ชัดเจน

prompt.default: one full-body subject in a high-fashion editorial contrapposto, approximately seventy percent of weight settled through one long straight supporting leg while the free knee bends softly and crosses a small diagonal half-step in front without locking or merging the legs, pelvis shifts subtly toward the supporting side while the ribcage and shoulders rotate gently in the opposite direction to form one elongated asymmetric S-curve, one shoulder lowers naturally and the torso remains lifted rather than stiff, the head returns slightly toward the camera with a level chin, complete head-to-feet figure visible with restrained negative space, anatomically stable and never a flat symmetrical catalog stance

label.th: นั่งคาเฟ่ไลฟ์สไตล์

description.en: A compact seated fashion pose with natural support and layered depth.
description.th: ท่านั่งแฟชั่นกระชับ มีจุดรองรับสมจริงและมิติของฉาก

prompt.default: one subject in an anatomically stable seated fashion pose on one clearly visible chair or bench, hips fully supported, torso upright with a slight natural forward angle, knees and feet placed clearly without crossed or merged limbs, hands resting together or making one restrained interaction, garment folds follow the seated anatomy naturally, show the complete seated silhouette and footwear without cropped limbs

label.th: หน้าร้านรับแสงแดด

description.en: An approachable storefront stance that keeps the face and garment readable.
description.th: ท่ายืนหน้าร้านที่เข้าถึงง่ายและยังเห็นใบหน้ากับชุดได้ชัดเจน

prompt.default: one full-body subject in a relaxed storefront fashion stance, rear shoulder blade and outer hip making light physically plausible contact with the storefront wall with no visible gap behind the body, weight carried by one leg while the other crosses lightly at the ankle with credible balance, pelvis and torso turned no more than thirty degrees away from the camera so the front construction and silhouette of the garment remain clearly visible, the relaxed neck returns the facial plane to within zero to thirty degrees of the camera axis with both eyes clearly visible, camera positioned on the subject's open side and looking diagonally along the storefront wall without turning the subject into a side profile, storefront wall visibly receding through the frame to create natural architectural depth, one restrained interaction with a garment edge only when available, hands clearly readable, complete head-to-feet figure visible with clean environmental escape space

label.th: แคมเปญฮีโร่มุมต่ำ

description.en: A close, confident campaign hero composed against rising commercial architecture.
description.th: ภาพแคมเปญฮีโร่ระยะใกล้ที่มั่นใจ โดยมีอาคารพาณิชย์สูงเป็นฉากหลัง

prompt.default: one subject holding a confident campaign stance close to the camera and dominant within the frame, with an elongated but anatomically realistic body line, one foot slightly advanced toward the lens, pelvis stable, torso and shoulders directed approximately fifteen to twenty degrees off camera, chin neutral rather than lifted excessively, arms in one restrained confident position, preserve clear garment construction and recognizable facial identity while the upward camera view creates presence without distorting the head, torso, hands, or legs

label.th: พอร์ตเทรตตัวละครนุ่มนวล

description.en: A dynamic identity-first close profile with professionally directed personality nuance.
description.th: ภาพโปรไฟล์ระยะใกล้ที่เน้นอัตลักษณ์และถ่ายทอดบุคลิกด้วยการกำกับอย่างมืออาชีพ

prompt.default: exactly one subject shown once in a close identity-first professional model profile, framed from the upper chest or shoulder line upward with the waist, hips, hands, and lower garments outside the frame; preserve comfortable margin above every strand of hair and around both shoulders; keep both eyes clearly readable and the facial plane within thirty degrees of the camera; allow the image provider to choose one natural shoulder turn between fifteen and forty degrees, one subtle head angle, and restrained human asymmetry that best expresses the supplied personality while keeping the neck anatomically relaxed, the face recognizable, and the eyes dominant; never use a rigid passport stance and never widen to a half-body, three-quarter-body, full-body, multi-view, or environmental portrait

label.th: เอดิทอเรียลแสงสี

description.en: A strong asymmetrical fashion line designed for controlled color lighting.

label.th: นุ่มนวลเป็นธรรมชาติ

label.th: มินิมอลสะอาดตา

prompt.default: interpret the selected base pose as clean minimal fashion direction with precise quiet geometry, restrained counter-angles, uncluttered limbs and a clear garment-first silhouette, while preserving the selected action, crop, camera direction and physically necessary support

label.th: เอดิทอเรียลมั่นใจ

prompt.default: interpret the selected base pose with confident editorial fashion presence by strengthening its existing asymmetry through anatomically plausible pelvis, ribcage and shoulder counter-direction, one deliberate non-mirrored hand line and a composed lifted posture, without replacing the selected action, crop, camera direction, garment-safe constraints, or environmental contact

label.th: แฟชั่นเคลื่อนไหว

prompt.default: interpret the selected base pose with controlled fashion energy: show one readable instant of movement, credible weight transfer, separated limbs and restrained garment response while retaining anatomical balance, the selected action, crop, camera direction, product visibility and environmental contact; never add a second pose, duplicate person, contact sheet, exaggerated jump or uncontrolled motion blur
